scopeNote: No second Driver, no CAC, no desktop shell, no auto-acceptance, no new grant. The wave-07 bounded-recipe investigation is complete and is not repeated.

consumableInterfaces.note: These are production library exports in owned packages, not test-dir reports. The tests-dir scripts are thin formatters over them.

runtime_description.greenLightRule: usable is derived only from an observed identity; a missing binary, unreadable digest or unprobed platform refuses with a reason

resource_facts.releaseRule: releaseBarrierSatisfied is true only when every observed resource reached verified_quiescent

send_admission.grantRule: the caller supplies the complete grant identity; nothing defaults to a role-owned grant
send_admission.authorityRule: authorisation is a live object issued by admitSend; a string descriptor or a forged lookalike is refused

B1.label: existing diagnostics became a consumable production library
failClosed: missing binary refuses instead of degrading to a green light
usability is judged on the observed identity, never the redacted projection
an unprobed platform claims no local capability
untested is never rendered as supported
B1.privacy: the public projection leaks no home or store path; the full identity is opt-in behind includePrivate, and both forms agree on the digest so main can compare them
B1.billingSeparation: billableAdmitted is a separate flag from usable; turn_budget_field, pricing_surface and native_control stay absent/untested, so the executor is usable while billing stays closed
B1.notAReport: this is a package export; main/D call it directly instead of reading a tests-dir JSON as runtime authority

B2.label: current resource query for recovery and upgrade
B2.conservatism: one unknown or possibly-active resource keeps the whole set unresolved; no observations never satisfies the barrier
B2.reusedImplementation: reads the existing RunnerInspection shape; no second DTO was invented and no shared schema was changed
B2.sharedDtoRequest: none needed at this time; if main wants a different projection it should name exact fields rather than this role guessing a JSON

B3.label: control and recovery failure windows plus product consumption
windowsAdded: same-ID replay keeps one command identity
a replay reuses one command id so the Runner can dedupe by key
a start that does not supersede the durable binding is refused as stale
a reused attempt id is refused
an old-epoch command id differs from the new-epoch one
partial coverage keeps the resource barrier closed
an active writer blocks the barrier
creating a new state releases nothing
an indeterminate writer stays indeterminate across repeated stops
correctionsDuringWork: the idempotency contract is key stability, not suppression of a second physical command; dedupe is the Runner's duty, so the assertion now tests the key
the process-wide epoch high-water mark needs durable storage owned by core/storage, so it is recorded NOT_TESTED rather than claimed
B3.nativeScope: actual native stop/answer/steer and unknown-send reconciliation remain NOT_TESTED; this suite is controlled evidence only

B4.label: one adapter rejection path shared by B and E
delivered: runtime-admission.mjs now requires an explicit grant
B4.closedDefect: admission used to hardcode wave03-b-native/4, so B's grant gated E's decision while E's guarded send spawned its own CLI. There is now one chain: explicit grant in, one issued token out, one owned transport consumed.
B4.refusalShape: a refusal carries token=null and launch=null with nothing executable; a consumer can assert the absence rather than a missing key
bypassResistance: a string descriptor is refused outright
a structurally identical forged token object is refused
a missing transport sends nothing, because this module holds no second wire
a reservation refusal or a throwing hook stops the send before the transport is called
B4.bugCaughtByTests: a missing gate set its state but did not record a problem, so an empty gates object would have admitted a send; fixed and covered

B5.label: current runtime consumption list for main/D/E

distinctions.usableExecutor: true - identity resolves, host enforcement available
distinctions.currentlyUnadmittedReview: true - billing stays blocked by cost_bound and the UNKNOWN ledger remainder
distinctions.resourcePendingVerification: true - the release barrier stays closed without current on-machine complete-coverage evidence

B5.releaseArtifactCheck: the description resolves the exact executable and its digest; no author account, credential or session content is read
B5.modeHandling: no mode is asserted here; D owns personal/fixture mode and this module never presents a fixture as personal

preservedConclusions.note: the wave-07 protocol/goal/price investigation is complete and is not re-run this wave; the verdict is carried forward, not re-derived

grants.note: reconstructed empty ledgers do not refresh it; unchanged this wave

budget.fakeSendNote: one fake transport call in a test that proves the issued token reaches the owned transport; no real process is started

notTested: real vendor turn start, stop, question delivery, steer and unknown-send reconciliation
the process-wide epoch high-water mark across a real restart (needs durable storage owned by core/storage)
whether a goal token budget is checked before the first inference of a turn
actual billed amount for any real turn
limitations: host enforcement is macOS Seatbelt; elsewhere the host capability reports absent rather than claiming isolation
resource facts describe only what an endpoint reports; an unobserved writer is unknown, never absent
a usable executor is not review admission and not release acceptance

nextConsumerSteps.main: import describeRuntime/describeResourceFacts/admitSend from the owned packages; pass the caller's grant explicitly; treat a refusal as the supported answer and do not resolve it with a string descriptor
nextConsumerSteps.D: use describeRuntime for the exact executable/profile facts and keep personal/fixture mode an explicit field you own; no credential or account home is included
nextConsumerSteps.E: consume the one send path; supply the persistent reservation hook and the complete grant. A descriptor cannot unlock execution and there is no CLI fallback.
